changelog: Fix: Backup Reports showed nonsensical dates — 'Oldest Backup 11/5/58607' and similar. Backup timestamps arrive from the API already in milliseconds, and the Reports page multiplied them by 1000 a second time, placing every date around the year 58600.

The same double conversion affected the oldest/newest backup summary, the per-endpoint last backup and last image columns, and both the CSV and PDF exports. All five are corrected; no other page was affected.
Adds the MIT LICENSE file that backend/package.json has always declared, and a rewritten README aimed at UrBackup administrators evaluating the project.
